title: Warm Dense Tunisian Mung Bean Sprouts Tagine
description: A floral and dense Tunisian dish featuring mung bean sprouts, cooked to perfection in a tagine, perfect for a romantic evening. This dish is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mung bean sprouts and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the sprouts are very tender.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
